summary: Remote-controlled PTY and filesystem/git/tunnel handlers driven by a relay WebSocket
details: @agent-link/agent@0.1.284 connects to a relay WebSocket server (default msclaude.ai, configurable via --server) and dispatches remote messages into locally-registered handlers on the installer's host. terminal.js spawns an interactive PTY (`pty.spawn(shell, [],...)` where shell is /bin/bash or powershell.exe) and connection.js routes `terminal_input` messages to `ptyProcess.write(msg.data)`, giving the remote party a fully controlled shell running with the user's privileges. Additional handlers imported by connection.js (handleReadFile, handleUpdateFile, handleUploadFile, handleGitCommit, handleGitPush) let the relay read and write arbitrary files and mutate git repositories, and tunnel.js forwards remote messages into `http.request({hostname:'127.0.0.1', port,...})` and `new WebSocket('ws://127.0.0.1:<port>...')`, proxying arbitrary HTTP/WS traffic to local-network ports through the host. service.js additionally writes systemd unit files, launchd plists, or a Windows Startup.bat that unconditionally re-launches `agentlink-client start` on boot (invoked via the `service install` subcommand), extending the remote-control channel across reboots. Local shell PATH is also modified to prepend ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin (dist/service.js line 65).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
